en.name: Pecans in the shell
en.summary: Pecans in the shell keep 2–4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 12 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). The shell helps, but pecan oil is fragile enough that the cupboard window stays short either way.
en.pantry: 2–4 weeks from purchase, cool, dark and dry, in a mesh bag or an open basket rather than sealed plastic. It surprises people that in-shell pecans do not get the long room-temperature life that in-shell peanuts do, but pecan oil is far more unsaturated, and the shell slows oxygen without stopping it. Keep them out of the sun and away from the hob, and buy them in season from somewhere with turnover.
en.fridge: 12 months from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. This is the sensible place for a bag of in-shell pecans, and the gain is large — weeks become a year, because low temperature is what slows the oil down. Store them in a paper bag or a loosely closed box rather than sealed plastic, so any moisture the shells give off can escape instead of collecting around them.
en.freezer: 24 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F). In-shell pecans freeze without any loss of quality, since there is very little water in the kernel. They take up a lot of space in the shell, so crack them first if the freezer is full; the shelled figure is the same 24 months. Bag them airtight and let the bag warm to room temperature sealed before opening.
en.thawing: No thawing needed. Bring the sealed bag back to room temperature before opening it so condensation lands on the bag rather than on the shells.
spoilage: A bitter, sharp taste in the kernel — rancid oil, which the shell does not prevent.
Shells that are stained, blackened or visibly mouldy.
Kernels that rattle loose and look shrunken or dark.
A musty smell when you crack a handful.
tips: Store in mesh or paper so the shells can breathe; sealed plastic traps moisture.
Crack a few from different parts of the bag before serving.
Shell before freezing if space is tight — the timeline does not change.
Keep them out of sunlight; light drives rancidity in the kernel through the shell over time.

faq.q: How long do pecans in the shell keep?
faq.a: 2–4 weeks from purchase in the cupboard, 12 months in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 24 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).
If you are keeping them more than a few weeks, yes. The shell slows oxidation but does not stop it, and the fridge multiplies the life many times over.

faq.q: How can you tell if pecans in the shell have gone bad?
faq.a: Crack a few and taste them. Bitter, oily kernels mean rancidity; stained shells or a musty smell mean the bag goes.

zh.name: 帶殼胡桃
zh.summary: 帶殼胡桃自購買日起，放櫥櫃 2～4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月。殼確實有幫助，但胡桃油脆弱到就算帶殼，常溫的窗口還是很短。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、避光、乾燥，自購買日起 2～4 週；用網袋或敞口籃子，不要密封塑膠袋。很多人會意外：帶殼胡桃並沒有像帶殼花生那樣的常溫長壽命，因為胡桃油不飽和的程度高得多，殼只能拖慢氧氣、擋不住它。請避免日曬、遠離爐台，並且在產季跟流通快的店家買。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下，自購買日起 12 個月。一袋帶殼胡桃合理的去處就是這裡，而且收穫很大——幾週變成一年，因為真正拖慢油脂的是低溫。請用紙袋或蓋不緊的盒子，不要密封塑膠，讓殼散出的水氣有地方跑，而不是聚在周圍。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下，自購買日起 24 個月。帶殼胡桃冷凍幾乎沒有品質損失，因為果仁裡的水非常少。帶殼很占空間，冷凍庫滿的話可以先敲開再凍，去殼的期限同樣是 24 個月。請密封裝袋，並且維持密封回到室溫再打開。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍。請讓密封袋回到室溫再打開，讓結露留在袋子上而不是殼上。
spoilage: 果仁嚐起來苦而尖銳——那是油耗，殼擋不住。
殼上有污斑、發黑，或看得到霉。
果仁在殼裡鬆動作響，看起來縮水或顏色變深。
tips: 用網袋或紙袋讓殼透氣；密封塑膠會把水氣困住。
上桌前先從袋子不同位置敲幾顆確認。
冷凍庫空間緊就先剝殼，期限不會變。
避免日曬；久了光線一樣會透過殼推動果仁油耗。

faq.a: 自購買日起，放櫥櫃 2～4 週，4 °C 以下冷藏 12 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 24 個月。
要放超過幾週的話，需要。殼只能拖慢氧化、不能阻止它，而冷藏能把壽命拉長好幾倍。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷帶殼胡桃壞了？
faq.a: 敲幾顆嚐嚐。果仁苦而有油味就是油耗；殼有污斑或有霉味，整袋就該丟。
